label: Artist
description: Deceased artists and their visual signatures across painting, illustration, prints, photography, design, and sculpture.
notes: Individual artists who died before 2026 belong here; art.movement holds collective schools and traditions, art.medium holds materials, and art.style holds broader rendering styles. Values use familiar searchable names after “in the style of,” while look describes a recognizable visual signature rather than a biography or a required subject. Field and period are local browsing groups for the work most associated with the name, and do not constrain the depicted scene or exhaust an artist’s career. Aliases such as Moebius appear once, and living artists are excluded.
